name: SuperDepth3D
summary: ReShade shader performing Single-View Depth Reprojection. Reads the game's depth buffer (Z-buffer) and warps the 2D frame into a stereo pair. Can be applied to almost any game that exposes a depth buffer and supports ReShade.
compatibility_notes: Requires a game that exposes a depth buffer to ReShade. Does not work with DX12 or Vulkan in most cases (depth access restricted). Typical artifacts: halo/ghosting around object edges, incorrect depth on UI/HUD elements, stair-stepping on depth gradients.
